title: report.py service-templates --output-mode json
description: One table of every stored template (service provider + service id, all stored versions together), including templates no DNS provider has been probed for yet (every count 0), at most --limit rows. Support counts are current state; reach describes the selected import, named in the note.

rows.description: Ordered by reach_domains (descending) when a domain share is selected, otherwise by supported_count descending. Empty when there are none.

publicRow.description: A row's public columns - the static export's row (docs/schemas/export/service-templates.schema.json).

provider_name.description: Service provider name, falling back to its id.

service_name.description: Template name, falling back to the service id.

added_at.description: Earliest created_at of the template's stored versions; null when unknown.

total.description: Probe combinations (DNS provider x template version) on record for this template; 0 when it has not been probed yet.

supporting_providers.description: DNS providers supporting the template in any version, each counted once (GitHub issue #249) - the providers reach_domains weighs, and the supporting_providers of the service provider card's templates table.

reach_domains.description: Domains behind the DNS providers counted in supported_count, in the selected import; null without a domain share.

reach_pct.description: reach_domains as a percentage of the import's scanned domains.
